About

I like to solve story challenges from the root — long before a single frame is ever drawn.

Twenty-six years in the animated film industry have taken me across nearly every role in the pipeline — character concept, modeling, texturing, rigging, animation, and final image compositing — and into supervising teams and training many of the excellent hands now working in the industry.

I've worked across Africa and the United States on multiple language-based animations for a range of clients. Along the way, my work has earned between 7 and 17 awards per project — among them two Hollywood Discovery Awards and multiple Annecy nominations.

I am also an Autodesk Licensed Instructor.
